author: Boring_Business (@BoringBiz_)
text:
Former Goldman Sachs CEO Lloyd Blankfein on the difference between running a public company and a private partnership

From his conversation with Andrew Ross Sorkin from 92W

"In a private partnership, you get wealthy if you work there by your capital count rising. You do not care if you make it all in a 10 year cycle, or make it in 3 years and tread water for the other 7

You can make it evenly or make money in one year and lose money in the next. As long as after the 10 years, you have got it there

In a public company, its about your stock price. Your stock price is a function of your earnings times a multiple. And that multiple is predicated, in part, by the reliability of your earnings."

author: Common Sense Investor (CSI) (@commonsenseplay)
text:
War is crushing bonds right now…

But I’m still bullish on $TLT.

And most people are missing why.

Since the Iran conflict escalated:

• Energy prices ↑
• Inflation fears ↑
• Yields ↑
• Bonds ↓

Classic inflation shock.

That’s why bonds AND stocks are both struggling - the exact weakness of the 60/40 portfolio that we hear from every financial advisor out there.

History is clear:
War is bad for bonds!

Because:
- Governments spend aggressively
- Debt explodes
- Inflation rises
- Central banks stay tight

Bondholders get crushed.

So why am I long $TLT?

Because the market is focused on the present… while bonds price the future.

Right now everyone is pricing:
• Higher-for-longer rates
• Sticky inflation
• Endless deficits

But in my opinion that is not how this cycle ends.

Every inflation shock eventually breaks something.

And when it does?

We don’t get inflation…we get demand destruction.

That’s when everything will flip:
- Inflation collapses (accelerated by AI)
- Growth slows hard
- Central banks are forced to cut

And THAT is when long-duration bonds rip.
This is the part most people forget:
- Bonds don’t bottom when things look safe
- Bonds bottom when things look the worst

I positioned for this already.

At the end of 2025:
• I rotated heavily into long-duration bonds
• ~60% allocation

While everyone else was still chasing equities.

So far in 2026?

- Bonds are already outperforming stocks
- The “unpopular trade” is starting to work

And we’re still early.

Also -  don’t ignore market structure:
$TLT has been:
- Heavily shorted
- Pushed down into auctions
- Used to lock in higher yields for big money

That trade unwinds fast when it turns.

When the pivot hits, it won’t be gradual.

It’ll be violent.
Short covering plus rate cuts plus recession fears = vertical move in $TLT

The setup is simple:
- War → inflation shock → pressure builds
- Pressure → something breaks
- Something breaks → recession
- Recession → bonds win

So yes - bonds look terrible today.
That’s exactly why I’m bullish.

You don’t buy $TLT when it feels safe.
You buy it when nobody wants it!

author: Yin.银哥 (@YingeAI)
text:
CRCL暴跌原因：今天CRCL大跌超22%，是由最新的稳定币监管法案条款引发的。

3月24日（周一），加密行业从业者在华盛顿国会山参加了一次闭门审查会议，首次看到了参议院《数字资产市场清晰法案》修订版中关于稳定币收益的最新条款。 这份条款的内容令业界震惊，直接引发市场恐慌。

3月24日曝光的《Clarity Act》最新草案，核心限制有三条：

禁止因"单纯持有稳定币余额"而支付收益——用户把USDC放在账户里，平台不能再给你"躺赚"的利息。

任何奖励机制，在形式或效果上不得类似银行存款利息。

仅允许基于用户实际活动（如交易、转账等行为）产生的奖励。

这个条款是加密行业与银行业长期博弈后的折中结果——银行业主张稳定币不能和银行存款竞争，压力极大。

为什么这直接打击Circle（CRCL）

这里要理解一个关键机制的演变：

GENIUS法案已经明确禁止稳定币发行方（即Circle本身）直接向用户支付收益。

但有一个漏洞：Coinbase等第三方交易所仍可以用自己的名义向持有USDC的用户发放"奖励"，本质上还是利息。

Clarity Act新条款的目的，就是堵死这个"三方模式"漏洞，连交易所也不能再给用户稳定币收益。

这对Circle的打击是双重的：
影响层面具体后果USDC需求减少用户持有USDC没有收益，吸引力大降，USDC流通量可能萎缩合作伙伴收入断裂。

Coinbase靠稳定币奖励收入2025年Q3就达3.55亿美元，若被禁，与Circle的合作价值大幅缩水。

​商业模式受压Circle靠USDC储备规模吃美债息差，规模萎缩直接砍营收。

银行业推手
3200多名银行家联名写信给参议院，要求把收益禁令从"仅限发行方"扩展到"所有第三方中介"。 众议院金融服务委员会主席French Hill也明确表态："稳定币就是支付工具，不应该支付收益"。 这场银行业的游说，最终写进了Clarity Act草案。

output.summary: CRCL暴跌22%：稳定币收益禁令《Clarity Act》新条款冲击Circle/USDC

impact.reason: 监管法案禁止稳定币收益，直接冲击USDC需求和Circle商业模式

output.suggestions: 持有USDC/Circle相关资产需评估风险，关注法案进展

baseline.summary: Clarity Act新草案禁止稳定币收益，USDC需求和Circle合作价值将受冲击

author: Jerry Liu (@jerryjliu0)
text:
There’s not that many fast, free, non-VLM document parsers out there: there’s PyPDF, PyMuPDF, Markitdown, OpenDataLoader.

Last week, we launched LiteParse ⚡️📄: a fast, free, and non-VLM based document parser that provides the highest quality context to AI agents compared to other tools out there.

✅ It extracts document text into an interpretable spatial representation
✅ It has native screenshotting capabilities to let agents (e.g. Claude Code) to do a “fast and light” text parsing step, and then a “deep-dive” into specific page content by feeding the screenshot into itself.
✅ It supports out-of-the-box integrations with other tools like PaddleOCR (@PaddlePaddle)

Check out our benchmark below against the other tools. We use LLM QA performance to measure the ability for LLMs to semantically understand the parsed text, and also measure latency.

If you try it out, we’d love to get your feedback. The repo is here: https://t.co/JNER0mVcB8

If you’re looking for a more accurate, VLM-native solution that can parse any document at scale, LlamaParse might be better for you! https://t.co/TqP6OT5U5O

author: Writer 🔶 BNB (@zhuilong888)
text:
Aster上线了质押，散户可以将 ASTER 代币，委托给网络验证节点，并按周获得收益。

最多可以锁 208 周。奖励权重由 veASTER 数量决定，veASTER 数量是根据锁定时长决定；比如你锁满时间可能是1:1的兑换，但如果你只锁定一周，可能一个ASTER只给你0.1个eASTER的数量。

锁定奖励按周计算，所以如果要参与，应该在周一 00:00 UTC 前进行质押，否则你锁定的当周可能就不计算奖励，什么意思呢；比如你周一 00:00 UTC前面几分钟质押，下周你就有奖励，如果你在周一 00:00 UTC后面几分钟质押，那你质押的当周的奖励也就没了！

author: StockMarket.News (@_Investinq)
text:
Trump just gave Iran 48 hours to open the world's most important waterway, or the United States will destroy its power grid.

One month ago, the US and Israel launched Operation Epic Fury, nearly 900 strikes in 12 hours  killing Iran's Supreme Leader in the opening wave.

Iran's response was not surrender but rather the Strait of Hormuz.

That narrow 33-kilometer stretch of water carries roughly 20% of the entire world's oil supply every single day, and Iran shut it down.

But here is what almost no one is talking about. 

Look at a map of Iran, really look at it.

Iran is surrounded by two of the most brutal mountain ranges on earth, and they have protected this country from every invader for thousands of years.

To the west stands the Zagros Mountains, over 1,500 kilometers long, with peaks above 4,000 meters. 

To the north runs the Alborz range, with Mount Damavand rising to 5,610 meters, the highest peak in the entire Middle East.

Between those two mountain walls sit two of the most inhospitable deserts on the planet and Iran as a whole is geographically larger than Germany, France, Spain, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Italy combined.

There are zero US boots on the ground inside Iran, and the terrain is the reason.

Iran tunneled its nuclear and missile sites deep into the Zagros Mountains, carving facilities into folded limestone and sandstone so the geology itself becomes the armor.

That is why nearly 900 air strikes have not ended this war. 

You can bomb what you can find, and the mountain fortress is hiding what you cannot.

Oil prices have surged 40-50% since the war began, Brent crude is now trading around $103 a barrel, and Bloomberg called it the worst supply disruption in the history of the oil market.

Iran has also mined the strait, fired missiles at Gulf energy facilities, and banned all ships flagged to the US- Israel, and their allies from passing through.

And tonight at 7:44 PM, Trump posted directly on Truth Social: 

"If Iran doesn't FULLY OPEN the Strait of Hormuz within 48 HOURS, the United States will hit and obliterate their POWER PLANTS, starting with the BIGGEST ONE FIRST."

That biggest plant is almost certainly Bushehr , Iran's nuclear power plant sitting directly on the Persian Gulf coast and Iran's own Foreign Minister has already said its targeting would trigger "zero restraint."

This is the same Trump who told PBS just days ago that he had deliberately avoided power plants because the civilian damage would be catastrophic. 

Tonight he is threatening exactly that.

Just hours before this ultimatum, Trump posted that the US was considering winding down military operations entirely. 

Then came this threat.

The Pentagon simultaneously announced the deployment of three more warships and 2,500 additional Marines, the second such deployment in a single week  bringing total US forces in the region to roughly 50,000 troops.

The mountains absorbed 900 air strikes and protected Iran's most critical infrastructure. 

Now, unable to finish the war from the air, Trump is threatening to turn off the lights for 90 million people instead.

The 48-hour clock started at 7:44 PM Eastern on Saturday, March 21, and the deadline hits late Monday night. 

Every barrel of oil on earth is now priced against what happens next
